questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

He said, "Shall I ever reach my destination?"

options.text: He said he shall never reach his destination.
He wondered if he would ever reach his destination.
He said to me I shall never reach my destination
He said I shall never reach his destination

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He wondered if he would ever reach his destination.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Shall I ever reach my destination?" becomes "He wondered if he would ever reach his destination."**
 
 
• Interrogative sentence in direct speech is changed to a statement in indirect speech.
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the third person reporting.
 
• Verb "shall" is changed to "would" to match the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Indirect speech does not require quotation marks.
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He wondered if he would ever reach his destination.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Incorrect conversion of "shall" to "shall" instead of "would."
 
• Does not convey the interrogative sense of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said to me I shall never reach my destination." 
 
 
• Does not correctly convert to indirect speech.
 
• Incorrect use of pronouns.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said I shall never reach his destination."

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. They will have to pull down this building as they have not complied with the building regulations of the city.

options.text: This building will have to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with
This building is to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with by them
This building will be pulled down as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with by them
This building needs to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They will have to pull down this building as they have not complied with the building regulations of the city."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "this building" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "will have to pull down" to "will have to be pulled down" (future obligation passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "them."
 
• Ensure the reason "as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This building will have to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"This building is to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with by them." – Incorrect due to the change in modality ("is to be" instead of "will have to be").
 
• **Option 3: **"This building will be pulled down as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with by them." – Incorrect as it changes the obligation meaning.
 
• **Option 4: **"This building needs to be pulled down by them as the building regulations of the city have not been complied with." – Incorrect due to the change in modality ("needs to be" instead of "will have to be").

__

• Oxygen is generated during the light-dependent reactions, not the light-independent reactions.
 
• These reactions take place in the stroma of the chloroplasts and play a crucial role in carbon fixation.
 
• The Calvin cycle is essential for synthesizing glucose, which serves as an energy source for plants and other organisms.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
